Package com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.enemy

Class RatNest

java.lang.Object
com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.Entity
com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.character.Character
com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.enemy.Enemy
com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.enemy.RatNest
All Implemented Interfaces:
Damageable, Rewindable, Collidable, Updatable
public final class RatNest extends Enemy
The rat nest (GDD 1.3): a static summoner that spawns rats while it sees its target. Its attack speed is its summon rate (0.25 = one rat every 4 seconds) and it keeps at most maxSummons of its rats alive; a dead rat frees a slot. Its rats are summoned, so they never drop loot (Q16). It never moves: its speed is 0 and it never chases.

Pattern: Template Method (fills the Enemy hooks for a summoner) .

  • Constructor Details

    • RatNest

      public RatNest(EnemySetup setup, String summonId, int maxSummons, Summoner summoner)
      Creates a rat nest.
      Parameters:
      setup - the values every enemy shares; must not be null
      summonId - the id of the enemy it spawns, e.g. "rat"; must not be blank
      maxSummons - how many of its summons may be alive at once; 1 or more
      summoner - builds the enemies it spawns; must not be null
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if setup, summonId or summoner is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if summonId is blank or maxSummons is below 1
